BG_017.name: Rosa's Bakery Exterior
BG_017.prompt: a small round stone bakery with a conical shingle roof, a crooked brick chimney, a round porthole window and a blue wooden door, standing at the edge of the Thistledown village square

variants.NIGHT: deep-indigo night, warm amber light from the windows
variants.FLOATING: the bakery hovering high in the night sky on a pillow of glowing golden dough, village rooftops tiny far below
variants.DAWN: soft pink-gold dawn, the bakery back on its stone foundation

BG_006.name: Rosa's Bakery Interior
BG_006.prompt: a cozy round wooden bakery interior with a glowing brick dome oven, wooden shelves stacked with golden loaves and rolls, flour sacks, a big wooden kneading table, copper pans hanging, a round porthole-like window and a crooked chimney pipe

variants.NIGHT: warm amber oven light inside, deep-blue night through the window
variants.SKY: same interior but the round window shows stars and clouds drifting past and everything tilts slightly
variants.DAWN: soft pink dawn light pouring through the window

BG_007.name: Thistledown Night Sky Over Rooftops
BG_007.prompt: a sweeping night sky above the sleeping rooftops of Thistledown, thatched and tiled roofs, chimneys, the windmill and church spire silhouetted, soft rolling clouds and many twinkling stars

variants.DAWN: indigo melting into pink and gold at the horizon

BG_001.name: Thistledown Village Square
BG_001.prompt: the cobblestone square of Thistledown, a hilly storybook village of crooked half-timbered cottages with red and teal tiled roofs, flower boxes, a round stone well in the middle, strings of colorful triangle bunting, a wooden windmill on the green hill behind

variants.DAY: bright morning sun, crisp blue sky with puffy clouds
variants.NIGHT: deep-indigo night, warm windows glowing orange, lanterns on strings
